Error E-217 on a CP-200 pump typically indicates a problem with the mechanical seal. The seal-water strainer was almost fully blocked with sand, causing the seal to fail. To clear this error, you should clean the strainer and replace the mechanical seal with a new one, as recommended in the field service report SR-2026-1107. Additionally, it is suggested to fit a new wear ring and set the impeller clearance to the recommended value to prevent future issues. 

Please note that the specific steps to clear the error E-217 may vary depending on the specific situation and the recommendations of the field service report. It is always best to consult the relevant documentation and seek professional assistance if needed.
